learnings.learning: ALWAYS verify post duplicates before creating. User explicitly corrected this — check slugs AND titles with regex.
type:'post' in posts.json is MANDATORY for ad injection. isPost check in [slug].astro gates AdUnit and AffiliateBox rendering.
Docker images MUST use --platform linux/amd64. Mac builds arm64 by default, VPS is amd64. Without this flag, container fails silently.
The tallas page (/escoger-tu-talla-ropa-china/) accounts for ~60% of all impressions. It's a single point of failure AND the biggest opportunity.
LATAM markets (PE pos 7.2, CL pos 9.8) rank BETTER than Spain (pos 10+). Counter-intuitive. Content naturally resonates more with LATAM audience.
AliExpress affiliate link works globally — no country-specific links needed. Amazon ES tag (enjoys0d-21) only works for Spain market.
Ahrefs MCP tools return 'Insufficient plan' for all GSC and Site Explorer endpoints. Need direct GSC API or plan upgrade for automated monitoring.
nginx.conf redirects from old WP category URLs MUST use absolute HTTPS URLs. Relative redirects caused HTTP -> 404 chains.
Country-specific calculator pages (tallas-chinas-a-peruanas, etc.) with interactive JS perform well. Template is reusable for more countries.
317 posts but only 16 clicks/week = 0.05 clicks/post/week. Most content is invisible. Quality > quantity strategy needed.

seoTitle MUST be ≤60 chars, seoDescription MUST be ≤155 chars. Google truncates beyond this. The golden page had 75-char title — the CTR hook [Calculadora 2026] was invisible in SERP, explaining 0.6% CTR at position 4-7.
Golden page had 0 internal links in body — completely isolated node. Adding 8 links to satellite pages creates a topic cluster that boosts the whole group. Every hub page needs min 5 internal links.
nginx add_header inside a location block OVERRIDES all server-level add_header directives. Security headers must be repeated in every location block that uses add_header, or use an include file.

WP-migrated content can contain XSS payloads from hacked plugins, injected comments, or compromised themes. cleanWpContent() MUST sanitize <script>, event handlers (on*=), javascript: URLs, and dangerous tags (<object>, <embed>, <applet>, <form>). Only allow trusted iframes (YouTube, Google Maps).
NEVER use root@ for automated deploys. Created deploy@ user with Docker group permissions. Limits blast radius if SSH key is compromised. Root only for manual admin tasks.

CSP whitelist for AdSense requires many Google subdomains: pagead2.googlesyndication.com, googletagservices.com, adservice.google.com/es, tpc.googlesyndication.com, fundingchoicesmessages.google.com, ep1.adtrafficquality.google. If AdSense breaks after deploy, check browser console for blocked domains and add to CSP.
